schema: GEO-TOT1 per-q columns, q = q0 … q1 (index i is q0 + i). E_canon[N][i]: keys a/q, gcd(a,q) = 1, 0 < a < q, all partial quotients <= N (canonical CF, last >= 2). depth_sum: sum over keys of sum a_i (mean Stern-Brocot depth = depth_sum/phi - 1). len_sum: sum of CF lengths. type: index into types.
